q: How much starch was left after 4 minutes with amylase?
State the purpose of the tube with no amylase.
It is the control: it shows starch does not break down on its own.
Explain what is happening to the starch polymer.
Amylase breaks the long starch chains into small sugar (maltose) molecules: the reverse of condensation polymerisation (hydrolysis).
Calculate the mean rate in the first 2 minutes and in the last 2 minutes, and explain the difference.
First: 38 / 2 = 19% per min; last: 5 / 2 = 2.5% per min. Less starch is left, so enzyme and starch meet less often.
